descriptions.job-1r531rl:
About the Company

Sei Labs is a unicorn startup based in NYC building Sei, the fastest EVM blockchain in the world designed for trading. We're building a decentralized Wall Street. We're a lean, remote-first team that ships fast, takes full ownership of outcomes and builds from first principles.

Sei Labs is incubating a new US regulated exchange from zero to one. You'd be the first hire in your function, with the speed and ownership of a startup and the backing of an established company and an S-tier team (Robinhood, Coinbase, Google, etc.)

About the role

As Operations Lead, you will own the daily operating engine of our FCM: making sure every trade, position, margin call, cash movement and customer account is processed accurately, on time and under documented controls. You will be the first-line owner of the trade lifecycle and of back- and middle-office operations. You will work closely with Compliance, Risk, Finance and Engineering, with clear first- and second-line responsibilities. You will build the operating model, write the procedures and run them from day one. As volume grows, you will build the team under you.

What you'll do

  • Trade lifecycle and clearing: own end-to-end trade flow, including trade capture and booking, DCM/DCO and other applicable clearing interfaces, and the daily clearing files, statements and confirmations. Make sure data flows in and out correctly.

  • Reconciliations and exceptions: run daily trade, position, margin, fee and cash reconciliations, and drive breaks to resolution.

  • Margin and positions: run margin processing, margin calls and settlement, and coordinate customer liquidations or position reductions with Risk when thresholds are breached.

  • Treasury and customer funds: operate deposit and withdrawal flows across fiat and stablecoin rails, bank and depository movements, and dual-control approvals. Provide the reconciled cash, margin and customer-account data supporting Finance/CFO segregation and residual-interest calculations, and execute required funding movements under established controls.”

  • Account lifecycle and customer operations: own the handoff from KYC/AML approval into account opening, plus account maintenance, statements and tax-document workflows. Once live, own operational customer escalations.

  • Vendors and resilience: own day-to-day relationships with clearing houses, banks, custodians, funding rails and back-office systems. Run SLAs, incident management and BCP/DR, and lead launch readiness.

  • Controls and governance: write procedures, maker-checker controls, key risk and control indicators, and management reporting. Keep clear lines of responsibility with Compliance, Risk, Finance and Engineering.

  • Regulatory credibility: explain and defend the operating model to regulators during registration and exams.

What you bring

  • 6+ years of progressively responsible futures/clearing operations experience

  • Hands-on, end-to-end trade flow experience: execution, clearing, settlement and reporting.

  • Deep experience with position management and margin.

  • Working knowledge of FCM obligations, including customer funds segregation, daily segregation computations and books and records.

  • A clean regulatory record, with no NFA or FINRA disciplinary history.

  • Strong process and control design skills, and comfort writing the playbook rather than following one.

  • Data fluency (SQL or advanced Excel) and the ability to partner with engineers on automation.

  • Autonomy and composure in a 0-to-1 environment where priorities shift often.

Nice to have

  • Experience with fiat and stablecoin funding rails, or with crypto custody operations.

  • Experience with 24/7 markets or perpetual futures.

  • Risk operations exposure, such as pre-trade limits and liquidation workflows.

  • Experience standing up a new FCM, broker-dealer or product line.

  • Familiarity with back-office platforms such as FIS GMI, Rolfe & Nolan, Broadridge or ION, and with CME clearing tools.

  • Series 3 or equivalent registration.
descriptions.job-1xa8p9t:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to join our Payments Team, based in the Hong Kong. Payments is where OKX meets the real financial world. Our team has built and operates the infrastructure connecting OKX to dozens of payment channels across global markets, giving users deposit and withdrawal options that are fast, convenient, and — most importantly — trustworthy. That platform moves and safeguards user assets at institutional scale, continuously, across time zones and regulatory environments.
 
This is not a greenfield team looking for its footing. The team is established, the platform is in production at scale, and we are actively expanding — both in scope and in headcount. That combination is rare: you get the leverage of joining a growing team where your work visibly shifts the roadmap, along with the discipline that comes from a system already trusted with real money.
 
It's also an unusually good place to learn. Payments is a domain that's hard to pick up from the outside — every market has its own rails, its own settlement behavior, its own failure modes, its own compliance expectations. Here you'll work across a wide range of payment methods and channels, and you'll build the judgment that comes from operating financial systems where the stakes are real: how to design for correctness when money is on the line, how to reconcile, how to recover, how to keep a platform observable enough that you find problems before your users do.
 
You'll work closely with product managers, designers, and partner-facing teams, and you'll set the technical bar for the engineers around you — through design docs, code reviews, and the everyday habit of doing things properly when nobody's watching.
 
If you like the sound of a team where the problems are genuinely hard, the standard is high, and your opinion changes the outcome, we'd like to talk.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design and build the core. Develop high-scale, 24/7 APIs and distributed payment services across multiple cloud providers, using Java and Spring Boot as the primary stack. Own systems end to end — from design doc through production ownership.
  • Expand our global reach. Help integrate and scale new payment channels and methods across markets, each with its own technical, operational, and reliability characteristics.
  • Protect user assets. Build for correctness first: consistency, idempotency, reconciliation, failure recovery, and the operational tooling that lets us stand behind every transaction.
  • Set the technical bar. Participate actively in design and code reviews, giving and receiving direct, constructive feedback. Help evolve the standards a growing team builds on.
  • Solve the hard problems. Investigate complex distributed-systems challenges and drive them to resolution rather than handing them off.
  • Partner across functions. Work with product, design, and partner teams across regions to turn ambiguous requirements into shipped systems, and to unblock dependencies before they become delays.
  • Grow the team's capability. Mentor engineers and share what you learn. Seniority here is measured in leverage, not just output.
  • Stay curious. Keep pace with a fast-moving industry and bring the good ideas back.

What you'll take away from this role

  • Deep, practical fluency across a wide range of global payment methods and channels — knowledge that is genuinely hard to acquire anywhere else
  • Experience designing and operating systems entrusted with substantial user assets, where correctness and recoverability are non-negotiable
  • A track record of shipping in a regulated, high-stakes domain at real scale

What We Look For In You

  • 8+ years of backend software development experience, with a proven track record of building and operating high-availability, large-scale applications.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals — data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and software design patterns — and the judgment to know when to reach for which.
  • Ownership instinct. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tickets. When something's broken or unclear, you move toward it.
  • Ability to drive cross-team collaboration, managing complex dependencies and competing requirements without losing momentum.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, and comfort operating with autonomy in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication. You can explain a complex technical trade-off to an engineer and to a non-technical stakeholder, and land it with both.
  • Genuine interest in crypto or fintech, and in building things that make money move better.
Perks & Benefits
  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants 
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

descriptions.job-1a9h01d:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Tether Wallet is our self-custodial wallet, built to bring USDT and XAUT directly to the people who rely on Tether every day, especially in markets where access to stable money and savings is hardest. For that to work, getting into these assets has to be simple, fast and affordable. Our goal is to give every Tether Wallet user the best option to exchange any local currency or token into USDT and XAUT, wherever they are.

In this role, you will define and own the strategy for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT across our target markets. You will work hand in hand with our expansion teams to map the payment landscape in each market: which payment methods people actually use, which card schemes and bank rails dominate, and which on-ramp and swap providers can serve them. Based on that, you will identify the best partner for each market and bring them on board as a service partner of Tether Wallet.

This role sits at the intersection of product, payments and partnerships. You will own the outcome end to end, from the first partner evaluation through integration and the in-app experience to the conversion numbers after launch. If you enjoy turning a fragmented global payments landscape into a buy button that just works, we want to hear from you.

Key responsibilities:

  • Buy & Swap Strategy: Define and own the strategy and roadmap for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT in Tether Wallet, covering fiat on-ramps, card payments, local payment methods and token-to-token swaps.

  • Market & Payment Landscape: Work with our expansion teams to build a deep understanding of each target market, including dominant payment methods, card schemes, bank transfer and instant payment rails, mobile money, local regulation, and the on-ramp and swap providers active there.

  • Partner Evaluation & Selection: Define clear evaluation criteria such as market and payment method coverage, fees and FX spreads, approval and conversion rates, KYC experience, settlement speed, reliability and compliance standing, and use them to select the best on-ramp or swap partner for each market.

  • Partner Onboarding: Lead selected partners from evaluation to go-live as service partners of Tether Wallet, coordinating with Legal, Compliance and Business Development on due diligence, commercial terms and contracts.

  • Integration & Delivery: Translate partner capabilities and APIs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with engineering and design to deliver a seamless in-app buy and swap experience.

  • Routing & Optimization: Define the logic that decides which partner and payment method a user is offered based on country, currency, amount, price and availability, so every user gets the best available option.

  • Performance & Partner Management: Define and track KPIs across the buy and swap funnel, such as conversion, payment approval rates, KYC drop-off, total cost to the user and volume by market and partner. Use the data to improve the experience, manage partner performance and incidents, and regularly review whether each market still has the right partner.

Mandatory:

  • 5+ years of product management experience in the financial industry (banking, payment service provider, FinTech)

  • 3+ years of product management experience in DeFi or crypto industry

  • Good understanding of crypto wallets and DeFi features, including token swaps, DEX aggregators and on-chain transaction flows.

  • Good understanding of global payment systems and credit card schemes (e.g. Visa, Mastercard), including authorization, 3-D Secure and chargebacks, as well as local payment methods such as bank transfers, instant payment rails and mobile money.

  • Hands-on experience with fiat on-ramp, off-ramp or swap providers, or with integrating third-party payment providers and gateways into a consumer product.

  • Proven experience evaluating, selecting and onboarding external partners, and managing their performance after launch.

  • Working knowledge of KYC/AML requirements and how they affect user onboarding and conversion.

  • Technical enough to read partner API documentation, assess integration options and work closely with engineering teams.

  • Data-driven: experience defining funnel KPIs and using data to improve conversion and make partner decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with partners, expansion teams and engineers across time zones in a remote environment.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Elliptic is the leader in digital asset decisioning, we have built the most comprehensive platform for efficiently extracting crypto data and intelligence across blockchains with the greatest accuracy.

Our platform’s unrivalled uptime, scalability, depth and breadth of our data and intelligence means exacting organizations choose Elliptic for their compliance, risk management, intelligence operations and blockchain infrastructure needs.

Founded in 2013, Elliptic is headquartered in London with offices in New York, Washington D.C., UAE, Singapore and Tokyo. To learn more, visit www.elliptic.co and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

 

Do you want to be part of a team that helps solve problems? Are you excited about creating impactful content which helps learners excel? Do you want an opportunity to develop your own skills, and expand your understanding of the future of finance? If so, we want to hear from you!

The Role:

Our customers have varied learning needs, and training requirements to fulfil. Some have compliance or investigations experience in the fiat world, but are new to crypto. Some vice versa.

We understand that one size of training doesn't fit all. We work as a trusted partner, providing solutions to our customer's unique learning needs, whatever the stage of their own crypto journey.

This maternity cover role (a fixed-term contract of circa 12 months) sits at the heart of our Education team - you'll take full ownership of our education content and Learning Management System (LMS) operations for the duration of the contract, working closely with our Director of Education Product Development. You'll be bringing your experience, perspective, and ideas to the party!

Elliptic is building an AI fluent workforce. We invest in the tools, training and time for our teams to use AI well: every Elliptite has access to Claude, and we expect AI to be a normal part of how you work, not an occasional add on.

We are not looking for people who use AI the most. We are looking for people who use it best, with curiosity, sound judgment and full ownership of what they ship. Across our Product, Engineering, Design and Intelligence we're going beyond giving everyone the tools. We're setting new standards. Using AI to transform how we build and work every day to deliver on our market opportunity. Put another way our teams iterate alongside agentic systems applying judgement to build world class systems. What that looks like for this role is set out below.

This role is an Adoptive AI fluency role. That means AI is a default part of how you build and manage learning content, not an occasional add-on - you review what it produces critically before it ships, and can point to a specific workflow you've changed because of it.

What you’ll do:

You'll be working closely with our Director of Education Product Development, owning the full scope of our education content and LMS operations. While no two days tend to look the same, here's a (non-exhaustive) list, to give you a feel for the range of activities this role may encompass:

  • End-to-end learning design and build - building a compelling narrative and nailing the 'so what?' for learners and training managers

  • Building bespoke storyboards and learning modules for banking and financial institution customers

  • Building e-learning modules using Articulate Rise 360, Canva, and ElevenLabs

  • Refreshing, enhancing, and evolving current Elliptic Learn products, ensuring content remains accurate and current

  • Creating learning materials ranging from engaging 'knowledge delivery' to immersive, scenario-based practical exercises

  • Developing product-based learning to support and certify users of our blockchain analytics tools

  • Helping develop role-specific learning journeys across traditional finance, crypto-native, and government segments

  • Owning the day-to-day running of the Elliptic Learning Management System (LMS)

  • Enrolling and onboarding both internal and external learners onto the LMS, and troubleshooting issues as they arise

  • Having direct contact with customers and learners, supporting their overall learning experience

  • Working with industry-leading subject matter experts to shape content

  • Collaborating on content-marketing projects

  • Helping source, test, and deploy new technologies to enhance the learner experience

  • Confidently using AI tools (e.g. Claude, ElevenLabs, and similar) to optimise content creation, LMS workflows, and day-to-day tasks

  • Finding new ideas and opportunities to enhance the overall Elliptic Learn proposition

You will be a great fit here if you:

  • Have proven experience in end-to-end learning/instructional design, from storyboarding through to build and deployment

  • Have hands-on experience with Articulate 360 (particularly Rise 360)

  • Have experience managing an LMS and the associated learner experience (enrolment, troubleshooting, admin)

  • Have B2B and B2C learning creation experience

  • Have developed and deployed learning across multiple delivery channels

  • Enjoy collaborating with a broad range of teams and experts

  • Are comfortable communicating directly with customers and learners, including a "front of house" capacity when needed

  • Are confident using design and AI-adjacent tools (e.g. Canva, ElevenLabs, or equivalent) to produce polished learning content

  • Are comfortable using AI tools to support and speed up day-to-day content and admin tasks

Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. About the role

TRM is building a highly impactful, collaborative Environmental Crimes intelligence function, with one goal: disrupt the illicit actors behind wildlife trafficking and other environmental crimes, and add real friction to their ability to operate.

As our Senior or Staff Intelligence Analyst, Environmental Crimes, you will own TRM's intelligence on this category end-to-end. You will research, analyze, and publish intelligence on environmental crime networks and the crypto and financial flows behind them, combining on-chain tracing, OSINT, and off-chain data from partners into a picture that law enforcement, NGOs, and private-sector partners can act on.

You will also be the clear TRM owner for our partnership with United for Wildlife and Project Pangolin, serving a global network of partner organizations as a trusted advisor, convener, and the expert user who shapes how TRM's products serve this mission. What makes this role unique: you get to build a new intelligence category from the ground up, on the leading blockchain intelligence platform, with executive sponsorship and direct real-world impact.

The impact you will have

  • Build the environmental crimes threat picture. Research, author, and publish intelligence products (threat assessments, typology reports, trend analysis, actor profiles, network maps) on environmental crime and the illicit finance behind it, and maintain a reusable threat picture inside TRM's intelligence infrastructure.

  • Drive investigations to action. Develop and use a wide variety of intelligence sources, tools, and capabilities — on-chain, OSINT, and partner-provided off-chain data — to identify the wallets, entities, and off-ramps behind environmental crime networks. Produce structured, source-cited targeting packages that support law enforcement and partner investigations and surface disruption opportunities.

  • Own the United for Wildlife partner program. Replace fractional coverage with a managed, repeatable program across a network of 200+ partner organizations: case assistance, analysis, guidance, training, and onboarding.

  • Bring the community together. Organize virtual and in-person cross-sector, cross-border sprints and working groups aimed at real-time disruption, and collaborate with partners such as USFWS, HSI, DOJ, Interpol, UNODC, national agencies, and NGOs.

  • Scale your coverage with AI. Build reusable AI workflows for signal processing, target selection, and drafting, with human validation where it matters, so more of your time goes to high-judgment analysis and partner delivery.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in intelligence analysis, financial crime, illicit finance, blockchain intelligence, or transnational threat investigations.

  • Domain knowledge of wildlife trafficking, environmental crime, and/or transnational smuggling — or a closely adjacent illicit-trade domain, with a demonstrated ability to ramp fast.

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Join our Mission

We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

About the role

Infrastructure Platform Engineer runs the trading system infrastructure Flow Traders trades on: the global Linux fleet — trading servers, workstations and VDIs — and the multi-cloud and distributed-systems estate that sits alongside it. We also build and run the self-service infrastructure platform the rest of Technology depends on.

We are hiring two engineers into this team. This is a hands-on engineering role: most of your time goes on writing Terraform, building CI workflows and guardrails, automating toil out of the Linux fleet, and operating what you build. A lot of the shared tooling does not exist yet, and building it is the job rather than a side effect of it. The environment is trading-critical and runs across both on-premise infrastructure and public cloud, and you will work on both sides of that line rather than specialising in one.

To be clear about the shape of the seat: this is build-and-operate rather than architecture, strategy or management. There is architecture in it, but the bulk of the work is hands-on and there are no direct reports. A solid Linux foundation is essential across the whole role — it underpins both sides of the estate, and the cloud, container and Kubernetes work rests on it just as much as the on-premise fleet does.

What you will do

  • Write, debug and publish reusable Terraform modules that other engineers consume, covering both the Linux fleet and the cloud estate.
  • Design and own CI/CD workflows and guardrails in GitHub Actions — the policy checks, tests and approval gates that let engineers across Technology self-serve infrastructure safely.
  • Build and operate Kubernetes on both sides of the estate — managed clusters in cloud and k3s on-premise — along with the distributed systems running on it, particularly Kafka.
  • Provision and operate GCP, AWS and Alibaba Cloud resources through Infrastructure as Code.
  • Operate and automate the Linux estate: Foreman provisioning across VMs and bare metal, Puppet for host configuration, Ansible/AWX for application deployment, plus patching and lifecycle.

  • Typically 5+ years in infrastructure, platform or systems engineering. Fluent written and spoken English. Based in the Amsterdam area or willing to relocate — this role is on-site and is not remote.

Nice to have

  • A genuine cross-domain background — both Linux/systems and cloud/platform, rather than one of them plus a passing acquaintance with the other.

  • Kafka in production. Real Kafka depth would be a significant win for us.
  • Our fleet tooling: Puppet for host configuration management at scale, Ansible and AWX, and Foreman.
  • Bare-metal and datacenter infrastructure — provisioning, hardware lifecycle, virtualization (VMware, Proxmox) — and networking depth across routing, load balancing, BGP and multicast.
  • Financial services, trading, or another high-availability, latency-sensitive environment. Dutch is useful but not required.

About Open Standard

Open Standard is on a mission to build the world's best money, starting with the US dollar. We believe money should move the way data does: instantly, globally, at any hour, in any amount. Today, financial transactions are hindered by delays, fees, and inefficiencies that every business must bear. We’re here to change that.

Our flagship product, Open USD, is a stablecoin designed for the internet: programmable, global, and built to reward the businesses that champion its adoption. Launched in close partnership with industry leaders like Stripe, Visa, Mastercard, Coinbase, and Shopify, Open Standard already has over 200 top companies in its network. Our lean team is based in San Francisco and New York and is led by Zach Abrams, who co-founded Bridge (acquired by Stripe for $1.1B) and previously led product at Brex, Coinbase, and Square.

Money is the world's most foundational product. Join us to help redefine it.

Your role

As Open Standard’s first Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in bringing the world’s largest banks, payment companies, and fintechs onto the Open USD platform. From the day a partner signs, you will become their main point of contact, guiding them through integration, launch, and every stage of future growth. You’ll collaborate closely with product teams at our founding partners, including Stripe, Coinbase, Visa, and Mastercard, whose customers will be among the first to use Open USD.

This is an exciting opportunity to help shape Open Standard’s partner experience, take our earliest partnerships live, and convert a network of signed partners into a community of deeply engaged adopters.

What you'll do

  • Launch new partners quickly by coordinating across Legal, Product, Compliance, and integration teams, ensuring launches happen in days, not weeks

  • Develop tailored growth plans with each partner: define how Open USD fits their business, project transaction volumes for the first year, and identify key success drivers; lead quarterly reviews with partner leadership

  • Connect partners within the network to foster collaboration and unlock new value as more companies adopt Open USD

  • Serve as the single point of contact for partners after signing: manage launch announcements, handle reporting questions, and involve internal teams (Finance, Legal, Product) as needed

  • Own the partner demand picture: build and maintain partner-level forecasts that guide Liquidity, Finance, and Product planning

  • Continuously improve our onboarding and product by turning every partner’s experience into future best practices and enhancements

You may be a good fit if you

  • Have experience onboarding partners at a payments network, stablecoin issuer, or banking-as-a-service platform

  • Have worked in a network or marketplace business where facilitating participant connections was part of your role

  • Possess enough technical fluency to lead integration calls without needing a dedicated solutions engineer

Strong candidates may also have

  • Experience onboarding partners at a payments network, stablecoin issuer, or banking-as-a-service platform (if not already mentioned above)

  • Additional technical expertise to independently own integration conversations

Logistics

  • Location: San Francisco or New York, hybrid with a mix of in-office and remote days

Come work with us

Open Standard is headquartered in San Francisco with an office in New York. We’re a small, senior, and entrepreneurial team with high autonomy and trust. If our mission excites you and you meet most of the qualifications, we want to hear from you.
